stage.name: Penumbra Shipyards
stage.description:
The shipyard that built ships such as the Stultifera Navis has become a nest of Sea Terrors. The Inquisition has contracted Rhodes Island to eliminate them in order to salvage a Golden Age ship-of-the line that is still restorable.
<Condition> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<Hand of the Saint - Purification Mode> Bounces a 'Hand of the Saint' in the deployed direction, stunning and dealing damage to enemies it collides with, and clearing Nethersea Brand in its path.

nourished_runner.name: Nourished Runner
nourished_runner.flavourText: A Sea Terror that grew four limbs and has sated its hunger. It controls its body's movements using hydraulic pressure and possesses superior reflexes.

shell_sea_runner.name: Shell Sea Runner
shell_sea_runner.flavourText: A Sea Terror that grew four limbs, but lacks an internal skeleton. It seems to have once hunted quadrupeds on land.

floating_sea_drifter.name: Floating Sea Drifter
floating_sea_drifter.flavourText: A Sea Terror that floats in the air. It seems that the next generation will be even more proficient at swimming through the air.

nethersea_predator.name: Nethersea Predator
nethersea_predator.flavourText: A Sea Terror that has learned to use its chitinous skull to deal physical attacks, storing scraps of food in its body comprised of countless tiny creatures.
abilities: Cannot be blocked while on Nethersea Brand
Gains Physical and Arts dodge (disabled by certain negative statuses)

nourished_spitter.name: Nourished Spitter
nourished_spitter.flavourText: A mysterious Sea Terror that has sated its hunger. Its spit is a way to deal with natural disasters, rather than as a means of hunting.

nourished_predator.name: Nourished Predator
nourished_predator.flavourText: A Sea Terror that has learned to hunt efficiently. They themselves do not appear to require nutrients, instead reserving them for their lower-level kin. Before they die, they turn themselves into one last food source.
abilities: Cannot be blocked while on Nethersea Brand
Gains Physical and Arts dodge (disabled by certain negative statuses)

nethersea_spewer.name: Nethersea Spewer
nethersea_spewer.flavourText: Possesses a hard, chitinous shell that it uses to protect itself, possibly capable of sporulation or a similar function. A commonly seen Sea Terror where the nethersea brand proliferates.
abilities: Can attack all targets located on Nethersea Brand

ridge_sea_spitter.name: Ridge Sea Spitter
ridge_sea_spitter.flavourText: A mysterious Sea Terror. In the sea, it can spit at even greater speeds, fast enough to destroy reefs.

nethersea_founder.name: Nethersea Founder
nethersea_founder.flavourText: A Sea Terror that has inexplicably grown a chitinous skull. There is no corresponding organ to be found beneath it.
abilities: Spawns Nethersea Brand at its location when defeated

nethersea_swarmcaller.name: Nethersea Swarmcaller
nethersea_swarmcaller.flavourText: A rare Sea Terror, able to manipulate the tiny creatures in the air and on the ground to eat away at their surroundings even in the absence of the nethersea brand. They seem to call the brand itself to life, hence their name.
abilities: Continually inflicts Arts damage and Nervous Impairment in an area around it
Has Status resistance and is immune to Slow

nourished_brandguider.name: Nourished Brandguider
nourished_brandguider.flavourText: Even if not on the verge of death, they will still choose to expand the survival range of their kin using their own flesh and blood. Reminiscent of the Bishop's final journey back to Iberia.
abilities: After falling below half HP, spreads Nethersea Brand to tiles it travels over
After falling below half HP, gains increased DEF and Block requirement
